description: This file defines theme-related types, default theme object, and context/provider components for theming in a React application. It includes a Theme type, default theme object, React context, ThemeProvider component, a hook to consume the theme, and some base style constants.

methods.name: useTheme
methods.description: React hook to consume the ThemeContext, providing access to the theme object within components.

methods.name: ThemeProvider
methods.description: A React functional component that provides the theme to descendant components via React Context API.
